title: Standardized enterprise intake manifest and first-pass econ+complexity scoring
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Sales and CS provide feature asks for enterprise accounts in many formats (email, shared docs, tickets). That creates friction for PM/ENG triage, leads to inconsistent scoping, missed bundling opportunities, and ad-hoc prioritization. Goal: ship a standardized 'intake manifest' and a lightweight first-pass scoring rubric that Sales/CS can populate. The manifest should be machine-parseable (spreadsheet/CSV + standard fields) and drive an automated suggested priority score (econ vs complexity) and routing recommendation (Solutions Eng, PM review, Dedicated capacity ops). We want to reduce time-to-first-scope from ~7 days to <48 hours for inbound enterprise asks and surface bundling/cross-account commonality earlier.
acceptance_criteria: A 1-page manifest template with mandatory fields: account_tier, ask_summary, expected_ARR_impact_range, adoption_estimate_percent, technical_surface (API/infra/data), privacy_classification, must-have vs nice-to-have, supporting artifacts links
A documented first-pass scoring rubric and calculation notebook (econ_score, complexity_score, combined_priority_index) with example calculations
Automation: a Google Sheet template + Zapier/Slack hook that creates a Linear ticket with prefilled priority and suggested assignee based on routing rules
Pilot with 3 Sales/CS reps over two weeks and measure time-to-first-scope and alignment with solutions eng feedback
success_metrics: Median time from initial ask to triage summary <= 48 hours
>= 60% of pilot asks receive the system's suggested routing (PM/SE) without manual override
Identification of at least 2 bundling opportunities across accounts within the pilot
notes: We intentionally keep the manifest lightweight to increase compliance; mandatory fields are 6-8 only
Routing rules: account_tier = "enterprise" + expected_ARR >= 100k => route to Solutions Eng + PM; else PM only
We will track adoption by embedding a UTM-like source param on the sheet and logging submission timestamps
Design asked for a compact single-screen web form as Phase 2 to reduce copy/paste errors
